exposure: Delivery method (natural delivery vs. cesarean section)
outcome: Pass rates of newborns' first hearing screenings within and beyond 48 h postbirth
cohort: 600 newborns delivered at The First Affiliated Hospital of Shaoyang University between January 2020 and January 2023.
finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had significantly higher pass rates for their initial hearing screenings, conducted within and after 48 hours of birth, compared to those delivered by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had significantly higher pass rates for their initial hearing screenings compared to those delivered by cesarean section.
